page_title: BRE 1-1 CRY | Brentford v Crystal Palace 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Peter Bankes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
89' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

89' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' Surely that's handball by one of the Crystal Palace players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
84' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
84' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
81' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and Peter Bankes immediately signals a free kick.
80' Here is a change. Kevin Schade is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
76' 1 - 1 Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
75' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
74' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
74' Kevin Schade (Brentford) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
72' Substitution. Frank Onyeka (Brentford) has come on for Mathias Jensen.
71' Roy Hodgson has decided to make a change. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) replaces Jeffrey Schlupp.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Odsonne Edouard leaves the pitch and Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) comes on.
70' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
70' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
70' There's an opportunity for Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
69' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
68' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Mark Flekken to dive and make a save.
62' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
60' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Peter Bankes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
54' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
53' The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
51' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
49' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
47' Brentford quickly take the free kick with a short pass.

46' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Peter Bankes with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Brentford in a dangerous position.
46' Referee Peter Bankes blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
45' The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
39' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
39' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner.
38' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brentford.
36' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
32' 66:34 – the ratio of ball possession.
28' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
23' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
22' A cross from the by-line finds Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.

18' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Kevin Schade (Brentford) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the right side of the goal and makes it 1:0. Sam Johnstone was helpless.
13' The shot by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mark Flekken.
9' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Peter Bankes blows his whistle as Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brentford was in an offside position.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Crystal Palace will take the kick-off.
Peter Bankes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
